fact: The GSMA report lists the National ICT Policy 2013 among Malawi's prior policies and strategies on which current digital strategies build; it gives no adoption detail and the report is published 2026-08-20.

The ESMP lists the National Information and Communication Technology Policy (2013) among the policy framework relevant to the DMAP data centre and says the project aims to achieve its objectives; no adoption event is described, the 2013 date is the policy's title year.

In stakeholder feedback the project implementation team answers that the Digital Malawi Acceleration Project follows the national ICT policy in developing its components and programmes (undated consultation; document published 2024-09).
The UNCDF Inclusive Digital Economy Scan lists the National ICT policy among existing policies it calls outdated and needing amendment and updating to promote the digital economy.

The Digital Government Strategy states the Government of Malawi has developed an ICT Policy and National ICT Master and Strategic Plans, and carried out an ICT sector review during 2013-2017; no adoption date is given, so the document's published date is used.
The strategy's foreword says it will assist the Ministry of Information in implementing the targets in the National ICT Policy.
The strategy lists a medium-term action P9, owned by the Ministry of Information and Department of E-Government, to update the National ICT Policy, and an in-house review of it in its project table.

The essay cites the 2013 National ICT Policy for rural fibre being urban-concentrated and links a copy of its text in the ITU national strategies repository; the essay is the author's AI-assisted analysis, published 2026-03-31.
